```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(rstatix)
library(ggrepel)
```

## 1. Data Import

```{r load-data}
file_two_models <- "../output_csvs/qwen_comparison_grade_dist.csv"  # EDIT if needed

raw_two <- readr::read_csv(file_two_models, show_col_types = FALSE)
glimpse(raw_two)
```

We drop the first index column and extract the two score columns.

```{r clean-data}
dat <- raw_two[, -1]  # remove index column

model_names <- names(dat)
model_names
```

Extract both model score vectors:

```{r extract-vectors}
model_A <- dat[[model_names[1]]]
model_B <- dat[[model_names[2]]]

length(model_A)
length(model_B)
```

## 2. Combine for Visualization

```{r long-format}
scores_long <- tibble(
  score = c(model_A, model_B),
  model = rep(model_names, each = nrow(dat))
)

scores_long %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    mean = mean(score),
    sd   = sd(score),
    median = median(score),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## 3. Visual Comparison

### 3.1 Density

```{r density-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
scores_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = score, fill = model)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Score Distributions: Independent Model Comparison",
    x = "Score",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 3.2 Boxplot

```{r boxplot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
scores_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = score, fill = model)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Boxplot Comparison",
       x = "Model", y = "Score") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 4. Mann–Whitney U Test (Wilcoxon Rank-Sum)

Assumes **independent** samples.

```{r mann-whitney}
mw_test <- wilcox.test(model_A, model_B, exact = FALSE)
mw_tidy <- broom::tidy(mw_test)
mw_tidy
```

## 5. Effect Size (Rank-Biserial)

```{r effect-size}
eff <- wilcox_effsize(
  scores_long,
  score ~ model,
  paired = FALSE
)
eff
```

## 6. Mean / Median Differences (Objective Performance Gap)

```{r performance-gap}
performance_diff <- tibble(
  model_A_mean    = mean(model_A),
  model_B_mean    = mean(model_B),
  diff_mean       = mean(model_B) - mean(model_A),
  percent_of_A    = 100 * mean(model_B) / mean(model_A),
  model_A_median  = median(model_A),
  model_B_median  = median(model_B),
  diff_median     = median(model_B) - median(model_A)
)

performance_diff
```

## 7. Combined Output Table

```{r combined-table}
results <- mw_tidy %>%
  mutate(
    model_A = model_names[1],
    model_B = model_names[2]
  ) %>%
  bind_cols(
    eff %>% select(effsize, magnitude),
    performance_diff
  )

results
```

```{r save-results}
write_csv(results, "../statistical_results/qwen_norm_vl_mann_whitney_summary.csv")
```
